chunks: And when the stars fall, scattering
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the stars scatter in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah al-Infitar is often linked to the cosmic upheaval preceding the final reckoning, emphasizing the absolute sovereignty of Allah over celestial bodies. Scholars highlight that the 'scattering' of stars symbolizes the dissolution of the current cosmic order, serving as a profound sign for believers to reflect on the transient nature of the material world.
